functions.notes: Payne-Hanek __rem_pio2_large. 66-entry 2/pi table at linear 19200, init_jk {3,4,4,6}, 24-bit limb accumulation/distillation, ih complement/carry, cancellation recomputation, PIo2 convolution and prec 0..3 compression. scalbn is recovered 107.
